disposition_reason: Mean total selenium in fish muscle from three West African reservoirs; no selenium biomagnification.

study.design: field food web survey of three reservoirs with stable isotopes
study.method: total selenium by hydride generation atomic fluorescence spectrometry after microwave HNO3/H2O2 digestion
lod: MDL 22 ng/L aqueous; 0.022 ug/g dry weight for solids (Methods, p. 4)
study.qa: DORM-3 and TORT-2 reference materials; procedural blanks 21 +/- 8 ng/L; selenate conversion 109 +/- 9%

regulatory_or_exposure: p. 9: authors compare fish selenium with a cited threshold of 3 ug/g wet weight; all reservoir means were below it
non_numeric_findings: Selenium trophic magnification factor did not differ from 1; selenium did not biomagnify (Results; Table 4).
All fish had selenium to mercury molar ratios above 1; the selenium to methylmercury ratio fell with trophic position (Results).
